name: HubSpot Custom Object Multi-Level Association Validator

parameters.content:
## Multi-Level Association Validator
**Safe by default.** With no env vars set this workflow audits a SYNTHETIC Parent → Child → Asset fixture, changes nothing in HubSpot and sends nothing to Slack.

HubSpot repairs need ALL of: `SANDBOX_MODE=false`, `DRY_RUN=false`, `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true`, `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, an action in `REMEDIATION_ACTIONS`, and a passing mutation guard (orphan-rate abort + `MAX_MUTATIONS_PER_RUN`).

Slack needs `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=true` + `DRY_RUN=false` + `SLACK_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

See README.md · DISCLAIMER.md

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Associations (v4)
nodes.notes: Read-only v4 batch/read for every direction.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Execute Remediation Batch
nodes.notes: Association batch audit/log: v4 create + archive, v3 batch/update of integrity_status (crm.objects.custom.write).

nodes.name: Slack: Post RevOps Alert
nodes.notes: Incoming webhook. Only when SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=true and DRY_RUN=false.

nodes.name: Ops: Post Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Only when SEND_OPS_ALERTS=true, DRY_RUN=false and errors or a guard block occurred.
